units.name: Project and Supply Chain Management
units.evidence: The dedicated PSCM Faculty page groups numerous Project and Supply Chain Management faculty, including professors of Operations and Supply Chain Management. The full program page establishes the full name and purchasing, materials management and logistics systems remit. It is retained as a faculty area; the chair supervises Marketing and Project and Supply Chain Management programs, which alone does not establish a combined departmental name.

units.name: Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: The faculty page explicitly identifies the Department Chair, Industrial Engineering, and its industrial engineering faculty. The program page describes process efficiency, manufacturing systems and industrial engineering research.

decisions.reason: Replace recruiting shorthand with the full name of the official dedicated faculty area; a degree title alone was not treated as a department. The separate Industrial Engineering department was also checked.
